name: unslop-backend
description: Stop vibecoded backends from shipping 200-query N+1 loops and full table scans. Profiles, fixes, and proves SQL, ORM, and API speedups with paired benchmarks and exact golden SHA-256 parity.

interface.shortDescription: Profile, fix, and prove backend & SQL speedups with SHA-256 parity
interface.longDescription: Runs a 6-phase Measure -> Hunt -> Unslop -> Prove loop across API routes, ORM repositories, SQL migrations, async jobs, and export streams using zero-dependency benchmark comparators and exact golden SHA-256 verification.
defaultPrompt: Audit this backend for N+1 queries, missing indexes, SELECT * bloat, and async waterfalls
Measure baseline query counts and unslop ./src/api without changing API output
Check whether this ORM repository or endpoint is doing in-app aggregation or sequential awaits
